```sql
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
order_variant_lines AS (
    SELECT fo.id       AS order_id,
           pv.id       AS variant_id,
           pv.product_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM filtered_orders fo
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = fo.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
product_agg AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(DISTINCT order_id)     AS order_count,
           sum(quantity)                AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents)        AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT variant_id)   AS variant_count
      FROM order_variant_lines
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       a.order_count,
       a.quantity,
       a.revenue_cents,
       a.variant_count
  FROM product_agg a
  JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id
 ORDER BY a.quantity DESC, a.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De aggregatie gebeurt nu op `product_id` (uuid) en de productgegevens worden pas na de aggregatie opgehaald, zodat de brede rijen niet door de hele join en sortering hoeven. Omdat `products.id` de primary key is en elke variant een geldig product heeft via FK, verandert de inner join met `products` het aantal rijen niet. De kolommen, de volgorde en de ORDER BY blijven identiek aan het origineel.
